segments.ja507:2.1: Kāmā vā kāmasaññā vā, brahmaloke na vijjati;
segments.ja507:3.3: So tattha paṭisallīno [paṭisallāno (ka.)], eko rahasi jhāyatha.
segments.ja507:4.3: Ekaputto cayaṃ mayhaṃ, na ca kāmāni bhuñjati.
segments.ja507:5.1: Ko nu khvettha [khettha (sī. pī.)] upāyo so, ko vā jānāti kiñcanaṃ;
segments.ja507:5.3: Yo [ko (sī. pī.)] me puttaṃ palobheyya, yathā kāmāni patthaye.
segments.ja507:7.3: Ahaṃ kho naṃ palobheyyaṃ, sace bhattā bhavissati.
segments.ja507:8.3: Tvaññeva naṃ palobhehi, tava bhattā bhavissati.
segments.ja507:9.1: Sā ca antepuraṃ gantvā, bahuṃ kāmupasaṃhitaṃ;
segments.ja507:10.1: Tassā ca gāyamānāya, saddaṃ sutvāna nāriyā;
segments.ja507:11.1: Kasseso saddo ko vā so, bhaṇati uccāvacaṃ bahuṃ;
segments.ja507:11.3: Hadayaṅgamaṃ pemanīyaṃ, aho [atho (sī. pī.)] kaṇṇasukhaṃ mama.
segments.ja507:12.1: Esā kho pamadā deva, khiḍḍā esā anappikā [anappakā (ka.)];
segments.ja507:12.3: Sace tvaṃ kāme bhuñjeyya, bhiyyo bhiyyo chādeyyu taṃ.
segments.ja507:13.1: Iṅgha āgacchatorena [āgacchatorenaṃ (ka.) āgacchatu + orena], avidūramhi gāyatu;
segments.ja507:14.3: Bandhi naṃ [bhandhituṃ (syā. ka.)] anupubbena, āraññamiva kuñjaraṃ.
segments.ja507:15.3: “Ahameva kāme bhuñjeyyaṃ, mā añño puriso ahu”.
segments.ja507:16.1: Tato asiṃ gahetvāna, purise hantuṃ upakkami;
segments.ja507:16.3: Ahameveko bhuñjissaṃ, mā añño puriso siyā.
segments.ja507:18.1: Tañca rājā vivāhesi [nivāhesi (syā.), vihāhesi (pī.)], samhā raṭṭhā ca [raṭṭhāto (sī. pī.), raṭṭhato (ka.)] khattiyo;
segments.ja507:18.3: Yāvatā vijitaṃ mayhaṃ, na te vatthabba [vattabba (sī. pī.)] tāvade.
segments.ja507:20.3: So tassa gehaṃ pāvekkhi, bhattakāle upaṭṭhite.
segments.ja507:21.1: Tañca bhariyā palobhesi, passa yāva sudāruṇaṃ;
segments.ja507:23.1: Isī ca khattiyaṃ disvā, samuddaṃ upasaṅkami;
segments.ja507:24.1: Khattiyo ca isiṃ disvā, sīdamānaṃ mahaṇṇave;
segments.ja507:28.1: Yaṃ etā upasevanti, chandasā vā dhanena vā;
segments.ja507:28.3: Jātavedova saṃ ṭhānaṃ, khippaṃ anudahanti naṃ.
segments.ja507:29.1: Khattiyassa vaco sutvā, isissa nibbidā ahu;
segments.ja507:29.3: Laddhā porāṇakaṃ maggaṃ, gacchate so vihāyasaṃ.
segments.ja507:30.1: Khattiyo ca isiṃ disvā, gacchamānaṃ vihāyasaṃ;

lines: Tattha sabbakāmasamiddhisūti sabbakāmānaṃ samiddhīsu sampattīsu ṭhitassa rañño putto hutvā eko devaputto nibbatti.
“Ko nu khvettha upāyo so, ko vā jānāti kiñcanaṃ;
Yo me puttaṃ palobheyya, yathā kāmāni patthaye”ti.
Tattha ko nu khvettha upāyoti ko nu kho ettha etassa kāmānaṃ bhuñjanaupāyo.
“Ko nu kho idhupāyo so” tipi pāṭho, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana “ko nu kho etaṃ upavasitvā upalāpanakāraṇaṃ jānātī”ti vuttaṃ.
Ko vā jānāti kiñcananti ko vā etassa palibodhakāraṇaṃ jānātīti attho.
Tattha ahūti bhikkhave, tattheva antepure cūḷanāṭakānaṃ antare ekā taruṇakumārikā ahosi.
“Ahaṃ kho naṃ palobheyyaṃ, sace bhattā bhavissatī”ti.
Tattha sace bhattāti sace esa mayhaṃ pati bhavissatīti.
Tvaññeva naṃ palobhehi, tava bhattā bhavissatīti.
Tattha tava bhattāti tavesa pati bhavissati, tvaññeva tassa aggamahesī bhavissasi, gaccha naṃ palobhehi, kāmarasaṃ jānāpehīti.
